entries.reason: Each class that styles nothing in any cell, or whose rules matched and lost, found by the browser instead of listed by hand.

CSS clips nothing here (`overflow` is `visible` initially, CSS Overflow 3 §3) and the set's root casts no shadow in any cell, so the capture-backed root leaves its layers unclipped, and a ring at its edge shows as in the browser. A root that casts a shadow still clips, since Figma draws a spread only from a clipping frame (PR2).
The recipe build compiled `rounded-full` from source, `calc(infinity * 1px)`.
Fuse's built CSS writes `rounded-full`'s infinite radius as `3.40282e38px`, the largest float, which reads as the same infinite radius and draws the same corner.
The recipe definition's hand-written media omission, which a manifest may not hold. No captured cell renders in a forced-colors mode, so the capture lists the class as unshown, named below.

A class whose state no cell of the matrix shows, which the recipe build dropped under the definition's hand-written facts or omissions. A manifest holds neither, so the capture lists it as unshown, named here, until the matrix shows its state or the kit decides it.
